# VESC Config Saver

> Free, open-source web app that reads the full configuration of a VESC-based electric balance board (DIY Onewheel-style builds) over Bluetooth, explains every setting in plain language, and saves it as one JSON file. Read-only: it never writes to the board.

- Site: https://skermiebrotech.github.io/vesc-config-saver/
- Config viewer: https://skermiebrotech.github.io/vesc-config-saver/viewer.html
- Source code: https://github.com/skermiebroTech/vesc-config-saver

## What it reads
- VESC motor configuration (mcconf) and app configuration (appconf)
- Package configurations: Refloat, Float, TNT (Trick and Trail), Balance, and any other package that registers a config page
- Every VESC device on the board's CAN bus, including a VESC Express used as a Bluetooth bridge, and the VESC Express's own settings
- Firmware 3.55 to 7.01, including the built-in Balance app in firmware 3.62 to 6.02

## Safety and privacy
- Only read commands are sent (COMM_FW_VERSION, COMM_PING_CAN, COMM_GET_MCCONF, COMM_GET_APPCONF, COMM_GET_CUSTOM_CONFIG_XML, COMM_GET_CUSTOM_CONFIG, wrapped in COMM_FORWARD_CAN for devices on CAN). No write, reboot or firmware commands exist in the code.
- Passwords and PINs (VESC Express Wi-Fi passwords, Bluetooth PIN, TCP hub password) are replaced with "(hidden)" and never saved.
- Runs entirely in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.

## Requirements
- Reading from a board: Chrome on Android, or another Chromium browser with Web Bluetooth (Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet). Not Firefox or iPhone Safari.
- Viewing a saved file: any modern browser.

## Config viewer
Shows a card for every setting with its value, a plain-language explanation for beginners, a practical tip, the default value and whether it was changed. About 840 settings have hand-written beginner notes, covering every setting in VESC firmware 3.55 to 7.01, Refloat, Float, TNT, the Balance package and VESC Express.

## Tested hardware
JetFleet F6 (32s) with a built-in VESC Express, firmware 7.00, Refloat 1.3. Should also work with Thor 300/301/400, Tronic X12, and boards with an added VESC Express or an NRF Bluetooth module.
